video_title: Jeezy Says His Generation Failed Today’s Young Rappers

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy's influence as the soundtrack of Atlanta nightlife culture
quotes.excerpt: If you wasn't a Jeezy fan, you wasn't outside.
quotes.quote: When I moved to Atlanta, if you were outside, you were completely full time. From Body Tap to Magic City to Club Miami, you were the standard. That was playing all night long. So, basically, what Angela Yee is doing in Atlanta right now, he did that for years in Atlanta. He was the soundtrack to everything that went on around that time. So, if you wasn't a Jeezy fan, you wasn't outside.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy's early days observing Atlanta's music and sports icons
quotes.excerpt: I was the kid that was at 112 with the Porsche outside, but nobody knew who I was.
quotes.quote: It was interesting because you're coming out of the street and you're seeing the athletes and you're seeing the other artists. I was the kid that was at 112 with the Porsche outside, but nobody knew who I was. I was watching JD and them walk in and I was watching all them walk in and kind of have their moment. I seen the JDs, I seen Outkast. I was pulling up in the Escalades, 24s back then, like I was doing all that, but I wasn't known.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Magic City as the launchpad for Jeezy's music career
quotes.excerpt: Every hustler from every part of the world came to that club and it was like my office.
quotes.quote: When I got my shot and it came organically, and rest in peace to Nando, it really came from Magic City. That's where it came from. And that's Magic City, probably about two sizes the size of this studio. And every hustler from every part of the world came to that club and it was like my office. And I just knew in my mind if I could get them, I could get anybody.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the importance of rapping in the third person
quotes.excerpt: He just said you got to do it third person. I'm like, what is that?
quotes.quote: I was trying to rap and not tell on myself. He just said you got to do it third person. I'm like, what is that? So he told me what third person was and I was like, oh, I can do this shit all day. And that's when Jeezy was born. You know what I'm saying? Because I was able to rap in third person and that's when my career started to take off. And as far as like one foot in, one foot out, I'm going to be honest, I don't think a lot of people even know. And I'm proud of that now because like when I put out Thug Motivation, I spent all the money to put that album together. I got all, I did everything myself. I got a deal at Def Jam at the end, right? And this deal I got was around the time that the streets started going upside down. And I was just lucky enough to get a deal because I wanted to get my mom a house, I want to set myself up and this was something that I wanted to do. And so the whole Thug Motivation, like I was one foot in, one foot out, you know what I'm saying? Like I was literally like trying to figure it out, you know what I'm saying?

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy negotiating his Def Jam and Boyz N Da Hood deals
quotes.excerpt: I negotiated the Def Jam deal and the Boyz N Da Hood deal.
quotes.quote: I was just getting my deal with Def Jam and they wanted me to do this situation with Boyz N Da Hood. I negotiated the Def Jam deal and the Boyz N Da Hood deal. I'm negotiating all the fact that I know Jay-Z and he just became the president. I told Puff look, this is the number whatever and LA Reid and Hov was like, cool. We done the deal and you got to think for me, it was like, I didn't know the guys until we was in the studio and all them guys are very talented.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure of transitioning from street life to music success
quotes.excerpt: It was a lot of pressure because I was coming off the street.
quotes.quote: It was a lot of pressure because I was coming off the street. I was literally driving a Ferrari to the studio. We would do shows and get $200 and I got a Ferrari outside. It's not enough to put a little gas in the tank.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the importance of giving away music for free
quotes.excerpt: My grandma always told me like, you want something from somebody else, you got to give them something first.
quotes.quote: Also, too, I think that the way that I was doing the music, like giving it away because my grandma always told me like, you want something from somebody else, you got to give them something first. So I gave them my best work for free. And then by the time I got ready to get on, which was, I mean, you know, at first I thought it was, was, was, was a curse, but it was a gift, is when my album got leaked, you know, like two months before it came out. Thug Motivation got leaked two months before it came out, you know what I'm saying? So I'm like, I'm done. This is over with. But really, and truly, that's what happened. It leaked in the middle of me giving out free music. So all the bootleggers had it. And that's another thing streaming helped with. But literally, like, bootleggers would get your record, and I ain't talking about, like, I'm talking about they got a whole operation set up. You know what I'm saying? It's like, they still have that, though. Right. What is it about hip hop that like, if you don't see that in entertainment, really, like, it's still even in the streaming era, it's a huge thing that people try to. I don't, I don't think, I think that, you know, culturally, we'll pay for some shit early. You know what I'm saying? And I can't feel bad because you know how many Juvenile and Hot Boys CDs I brought in front of Magic City? You know what I'm saying? I couldn't wait.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Evolving beyond the rules of your teenage years
quotes.excerpt: Once you get to a certain level in life, you shouldn't be living by rules that was for you
quotes.quote: I even want the generation behind me to see like, you can still be you, but you don't have to stay the same. You can still live the life that you want to live, but you don't have to abide by the same rules. Once you get to a certain level in life, you shouldn't be living by rules that was for you when you were a teenager.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: The personal sacrifices required to achieve long-term financial stability
quotes.excerpt: I just had to really humble myself and I had to kind of budget a little bit
quotes.quote: It was a sacrifice that I had to make because of course my lifestyle was different from there because I was used to having and I just had to really humble myself and I had to kind of budget a little bit. I wasn't buying new cars every year, but then when it worked out, I just had to tell them one day we were just talking, I was like, bro, like nobody ever told me that, man.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on his upcoming residency in Las Vegas
quotes.excerpt: November 6th is going down November 6th all the way to New Year's Eve.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Before we get to rapid fire and get you out of here, residency, it starts back up in November?

text_blocks.speaker: Jeezy
text_blocks.text: November 6th is going down November 6th all the way to New Year's Eve.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on his criteria for collaborating with current rappers
quotes.excerpt: If I like you as a person, I like the way you moving, I'm down with that.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: One current rapper that you would drop a collab with?

text_blocks.speaker: Jeezy
text_blocks.text: For me, if I like you as a person, I like the way you moving, I'm down with that. I like a lot of these guys. Everybody been tapping me about Bossman Dlow. I'm just like, let me see.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy's favorite instrumental beats for collaboration
quotes.excerpt: The Formula, DOC, and a Hit 'Em Up Tupac.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: One instrumental or beat you wish you would have grabbed before somebody else grabbed it?

text_blocks.speaker: Jeezy
text_blocks.text: I would say two: The Formula, DOC, and a Hit 'Em Up Tupac.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the authenticity and impact of Tupac Shakur
quotes.excerpt: He believed he was who he was and he was going to live and die for that.
quotes.quote: I feel like he believed he was who he was and he was going to live and die for that. He was trying to put like even some of my uncles, they didn't have something they would live and die for. It was like it was fickle. He believed in that. And when you listen to the music, he was my therapist. That's how I learned the streets. I learned how to hustle from the Master P's and the UGK's, but a sense of purpose and direction, that came from Tupac. That's how even Thug Motivation came because it was just like, when he said Thug Life, that was what he meant. But it meant so many other things.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on his desire to have Michael Jordan as a guest
quotes.excerpt: Michael Jordan. I just saw him when I was in Portugal.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: If you could see one guest on our show, who would it be?

text_blocks.speaker: Jeezy
text_blocks.text: Michael Jordan. I just saw him when I was in Portugal. I told him I talked to him, you know, I'm sponsored by Jordan, but if you can get him, hey, I didn't told him a million times.

quotes.speaker: Jeezy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeezy on the importance of hearing from legends like Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: The culture needs to hear from him.
quotes.quote: You guys are the culture. The culture needs to hear from him. I just feel like a lot of those guys that came out of that, they're real. But we never heard them speak. When you hear people speak and hear their perspective, you get a chance to understand who they are. We just see Jordan, we don't know Jordan. I think that him coming here will give people a chance just to know him. He's a dope dude, Jordan is solid.
